name: ai-engineering-visualized-workspace
description: AI Engineering Visualized - Multi-platform workspace for Web, macOS, and iPhone

scripts.build:macos: npm --prefix web-app run build && npm --prefix macos-app run build:mac
scripts.sync:iphone: npm --prefix web-app run build && npm --prefix iphone-app run sync
scripts.build:iphone: npm --prefix web-app run build && npm --prefix iphone-app run sync && npm --prefix iphone-app run build:sim
scripts.deploy:iphone: npm --prefix web-app run build && npm --prefix iphone-app run sync && npm --prefix iphone-app run deploy:device
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:macos && npm run build:iphone
